why: This search is contested. Two big reviewers, Digital Camera World and WIRED, test laptop power banks and partly answer the screen question. Digital Camera World names a "best display" pick, the Anker Prime 20K. WIRED describes screens that show the charging rate for each device. Engadget tests too, but its guide is general. None of them compares screens directly. The rest are affiliate roundups and niche sites with spec tables. A page built around the screen, checking whether it really shows watts in and out on each port, could get in, but it would be up against Digital Camera World and WIRED.
